title: fix(polli-cli): configure OpenCode through a provider block so 2.0 works
author: SvirepyiBambr

gist.summary: `polli harness opencode on` now writes a native Pollinations provider using `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible` and `https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1`, replacing the plugin setup rejected by OpenCode 2.0. The provider lists models from the live catalog, stores the key in `options.apiKey`, and supplies a 32,768-token output-limit fallback required by OpenCode’s config schema; the same configuration works with OpenCode 1.x and 2.0. Re-running `on` removes legacy plugin entries and `pollinations/enter/...` model defaults, reuses a valid legacy key, and removes its old key file. `off` restores unchanged pre-setup files byte-for-byte or removes only Pollinations-owned settings if the config was edited. Media tools are installed separately with `polli mcp install opencode --all`; the docs and example model ID were updated, and `@pollinations/cli` was bumped from 0.1.48 to 0.1.49.
